## Your idea
Describe the animation, improvement or integration you would like.

## How should it work?
What should trigger it, and what should the player see?
Include first-person and other players' views where relevant.

## Why would it help?
Explain how it would improve your experience.

## Related mods
For compatibility or integration requests, include the mod's name,
version and official project link.

## References
Optional screenshots, videos or examples showing your idea.
